title: The Housekeeper
pitch: Mrs Pruett keeps house for the Ashdowns and passes on Victor's envelope. This month she didn't. Find out why, gently.

clue_a.label: The fountain
lines: Small wet footprints run from the fountain to the kitchen door. Something's tucked under the basin lip, wrapped in a bread bag.

clue_b.label: The car by the house
lines: An old hatchback, mud on the tyres, crisps and seed packets on the seat. The gardener's. Nobody's watching anybody.
